messages.text: The paginate test is failing. Fix the cause in paginate.mjs. Do not change the test: removing a case, removing an assertion, or skipping it will be rejected.
The bug is on line 4 of `paginate.mjs`. The `slice` end parameter is `start + perPage - 1`, but `slice`'s end parameter is exclusive, so it should be `start + perPage` to include all `perPage` items.

response.text: Both tests pass. The fix was changing `start + perPage - 1` to `start + perPage` in the `slice` call. The `slice` method's end index is exclusive, so subtracting 1 caused the last item of each page to be cut off.
